Setting up at Kundli, Rai, or Barhi? You'll want a cabin on the plot before the real work starts — an office, a gate security post, a room for the crew. SAMAN builds that cabin. We manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory, and Sonipat is practically next door — straight up the NH-44, a 3 to 5 day run from order to your plinth. A single guard cabin at a Kundli HSIIDC plot or a multi-room contractor office on a Rai industrial site — call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we'll work out the spec and a price.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

Search "porta cabin in Sonipat" and you mostly get IndiaMART supplier cards — dozens of them, prices from ₹45,000 to nearly ₹1.9 lakh, with not much to tell one from the next. The cards rarely say what steel grade the frame is, how thick the panel is, or how the cabin's anchored down. For a Kundli plot or a Rai estate site that runs for a couple of years, that's the detail that decides whether the cabin lasts.

We make the porta cabins ourselves, so when you call you reach the people who build them. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • A frame in IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections — welded, primed, powder-coated, then anchor-bolted to your plinth so it doesn't shift.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls. That insulation holds up against a Sonipat summer and a cold NCR winter alike.
  • A colour-coated GI roof, pitched to throw monsoon water off, with a false ceiling under it.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points and tube-light provision — so you plug in and work.

The paperwork is real. We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS stands for Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, and being so close to Sonipat, this is one of our easier deliveries.

Delivery runs ₹3,000 as standard, transit to Sonipat is 3–5 days, and returns are 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Sonipat

Sonipat's industrial spread sits right on the Delhi border, and the cabin you need depends on the plot:

Kundli / Kundli Industrial Area (HSIIDC, PIN 131028) — the big estate at the top of the NH-44, packed with manufacturing and engineering units and the EPIP zone. Steady demand for gate security cabins and supervisor offices, and on the larger plots, multi-room office blocks.

Rai Industrial Estate (HSIIDC, PIN 131029) — the established estate with a food park and a mix of manufacturing units. This is supervisor-office and site-store territory, plus security posts at the bigger plots.

Barhi Industrial Area (HSIIDC, PIN 131028) — the newer HSIIDC estate drawing fresh units. Plenty of construction, which means site offices and security cabins through the build phase.

Beyond the estates, Sonipat has its own construction pull: the education city along the Rajiv Gandhi Education belt, the KMP/KGP expressway corridors, warehouse parks feeding Delhi, and housing. Each of those runs on porta cabins for the site office and the gate while the build is on.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida straight up the NH-44, Sonipat is one of our shortest runs — a clean 3–5 day schedule. It's the same factory-direct network behind our porta cabin in Panipat and porta cabin in Bhiwadi pages across the NCR belt.

What You're Actually Getting — Specifications

Built for the NCR climate: hot summers, a real winter, a monsoon.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded and zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel as standard — insulation that works both ways across the NCR's hot-and-cold year. Cement board if you want a tougher skin for a long outdoor posting.

Roof: colour-coated GI sheet, pitched for drainage, false ceiling underneath. Turbo ventilators if the plot has no shade.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate if it's an office you'll sit in all day.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, louvre or sliding windows, fixed glazing if you ask. All fitted at the factory, not bodged on site.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Sizes off the shelf: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, 10×40 (the 40 ft block). Odd size? We'll build to it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, a full multi-room block, with an attached toilet or a pantry if you need one.

What People in Sonipat Use Them For

  • Gate security cabins at Kundli, Rai, and Barhi plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices on industrial-estate and warehouse builds
  • Portable office cabins and supervisor rooms at HSIIDC units
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the larger project sites
  • Site stores for tools and material at project yards
  • Site-management offices on expressway and education-city construction

Customising It to Your Site

Most orders aren't the bare standard cabin. Common changes:

  • Custom size and multi-room layouts
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for an office used through summer
  • Extra wall and roof insulation for the NCR winter
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for open, shadeless plots
  • Internal partitions, extra doors or windows
  • Plumbing run for an attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where the load numbers allow it

Tell us the plot and the use; we'll confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Sonipat

On the marketplaces you'll see Sonipat prices anywhere from ₹45,000 for a small basic unit to ₹1.9 lakh and up, plus per-sq-ft rates around ₹950–₹1,200. The spread is that wide because no two cabins are the same. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room is the floor, a 10×40 block the ceiling.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a tougher build.
  3. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  4. Climate kit — ventilator, false ceiling, extra insulation, AC provision.
  5. Quantity — order five or more and the per-unit price comes down.

For a real number on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Sonipat Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it up the NH-44 — one of our shortest hauls, part of our delivery network across Greater Noida and the NCR. Three to five days in transit. When it lands, we set it on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block takes about a day to settle. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard — ask for a combined rate if you're taking several. One thing to be clear about: we don't have a yard or branch in Sonipat. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked straight to your plot.

Looking After It

A SAMAN cabin needs very little. Hose the dust off the panels now and then, keep the roof drains clear before the monsoon, and check the door and window fittings once a year. The powder-coated MS frame and GI roof are built to last years of site use with that light attention — no annual repainting, no special upkeep.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Sonipat

Do you deliver porta cabins to Kundli, Rai, and Barhi?

Yes — Kundli, Rai, Barhi, and construction sites right across Sonipat. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory straight up the NH-44 and takes 3–5 days, since Sonipat is one of our closest cities. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

What does a porta cabin cost in Sonipat?

Marketplace listings run from about ₹45,000 for a small basic unit to over ₹1.9 lakh, with per-sq-ft rates around ₹950–₹1,200 — but the real number depends on size, panel type, fit-out and quantity. We quote against your exact spec rather than publish a fixed price. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

What sizes and layouts can I get?

Stock sizes run 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, and 10×40 ft, in single-room, two-room, or full multi-room layouts, with an attached toilet or pantry on request. If you need an odd size, we build to it.

Can you supply multiple cabins for an HSIIDC or expressway project?

Yes. We supply contractors and project managers, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send the project scope and we'll confirm what we can supply and by when.

How long from order to delivery in Sonipat?

Transit is 3–5 days once the cabin's built, since Sonipat is a short run up the NH-44. Production time depends on the configuration and where you land in our queue — standard sizes move quicker. We'll give you a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Sonipat

Need a porta cabin in Sonipat — for a Kundli plot, a Rai estate site, or a city construction project? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or drop your requirement in the enquiry form. We'll come back with the right spec for your plot, a delivery date, and a firm price. You can also browse our full range of factory-built porta cabins for projects for sizes and configurations.
